Stephanie / team — I ran a quick sampling against our accounts and sketched an initial mapping. See notes below and attached template (seller_mapping_template.xlsx). I'll drop the full proposed mapping into the Drive folder once we confirm the matching rules.

Quick notes / assumptions I used for the match:
- Match on azure_offer_id -> prefer existing committed deals / owned subscriptions; fallback to merchant_id region and account domain.
- If offer maps to a channel partner (reseller) we tag "channel-owner" and defer to Contoso partner ops for referral routing.
- We only set Partner Center referral owner if we can attach a HubSpot rep id or Redwood account owner. Otherwise we mark "needs-manual-claim."

Sample mapping snippet:
- merchant_id 98765 | sku_id S-234 | azure_offer_id A-778 | suggested_owner: Karthik Iyer (AM) | referral_mode: auto
- merchant_id 42109 | sku_id S-021 | azure_offer_id A-112 | suggested_owner: Neha Kapoor (Field) | referral_mode: manual-claim

Risks / blockers:
- Partner Center restricts referral ownership changes for offers created by the publisher; we may need Contoso to approve owner updates on your Partner Center record for some offers.
- SKU de-dup needed for cross-listings (same merchant offering multiple SKUs that map to one offer).

Next actions (my view):
- Vanessa to share full mapping in Drive (ETA: EOD Wed) — will include suggested owner and confidence score.
- Karthik / Neha to review and flag any account/territory conflicts (ETA: Thu morning).
- Stephanie to coordinate a short runbook for Partner Center intake and A/B test routing window on first 200 referrals.

Attachment: seller_mapping_template.xlsx (XLSX, 12KB)

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Cloud Partnerships (Americas)
Redwood Inference
